title: Code security scanner (secrets + risky calls)
blurb: A defensive static scanner for your own repo: finds hard-coded secrets by pattern and entropy, and risky Python calls through the AST (eval/exec, shell=True, pickle/yaml loads, weak hashes, verify=False). Baseline file to accept known findings, SARIF-like JSON, exit 1 on new findings for CI.
keywords: \b(security scanner|secret scan\w*|scan (?:for|my code for) secrets|sast|static (?:security )?analy[sz]\w*|leaked keys?)\b
